# Code Diff Card

Component ID: code-diff-card

## Narrative intent

在同一代码位置对照修改前后，让观众看出哪一行变化带来什么影响。

Select this recipe only when the current story event needs that audience outcome; the animation alone is not evidence that the outcome was delivered.

## Purpose and selection

- Explain one small before/after code change in the same file.

Do not use:

- Do not present unrelated code as a diff, claim tests passed without running them or cram in whole files.

## Supported inputs

- filename: Supply real file name within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
- before: Actual code in the same file: at most four lines, 58 characters per line. Keep the paired change comparable.
- after: Actual code in the same file: at most four lines, 58 characters per line. Keep the paired change comparable.
- summary: Supply real summary within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

## Reading order and motion

- Identify the file
- Read the old behavior
- Read the changed behavior
- Explain the difference and compare

Pattern: state-transformation. Native default duration: 9s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### before

- Target: .diff-before
- Visible action: Show the old code behavior
- Authored start: 1.2s; action duration: 0.6s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Show the old code behavior. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### after

- Target: .diff-after
- Visible action: Show the replacement code
- Authored start: 3.2s; action duration: 0.6s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Show the replacement code. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### explain

- Target: .diff-summary
- Visible action: Explain the behavioral difference
- Authored start: 5.5s; action duration: 0.65s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Explain the behavioral difference. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### resolve

- Target: .diff-pane
- Visible action: Restore both code panes for comparison
- Authored start: 7.6s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

These are authored event defaults, not measured speech alignment. Rebind active events to actual narration at project FPS; omitted capacity items must not acquire phantom cues. Preserve source easing, internal timing ratios and landing geometry. ## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a real explanation boundary; use a walkthrough for larger code, never silently truncate lines.
- missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
- timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
- inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.

## Example

~~~json
{
  "filename": "capacity.ts",
  "before": "return total - booked;",
  "after": "return Math.max(0, total - booked);",
  "summary": "避免可用座位显示为负数；是否有效仍需测试。"
}
~~~

Narration: 原来直接相减，修改后把结果限制为不小于零，避免显示负座位数。
